svg.title: Specifications
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, Python, C, C++, SQL. Interfaces: React 19, Next.js 16, Jetpack Compose, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Three.js, Vite, PWA. Backend & data: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Socket.io, Redis, MongoDB, BullMQ, Zod. Cloud & ops: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Docker, Caddy, Nginx, Vercel, Linux, Git. Security & AI: OAuth 2.0, Passkeys / WebAuthn, MFA, Argon2, MediaPipe, Claude API
